///- --package . --timeout 2400000
open xml_codec

prototype to_text t : t -> string

inl text_node forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : t) : xml.xml_node =
    xml.element name [] (xml.text_children (to_text v))

inl optional_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (v : option t) : list xml.xml_node =
    xml.option_list (optionm.map (text_node name) v)

inl repeated_text_nodes forall t {to_text}. (name : string) (vs : list t) : list xml.xml_node =
    listm.map (text_node name) vs

nominal lexical t = { value : t; text : string }

instance to_text lexical t = fun x => x.text

inl lexical_of forall t. (text : string) (value : option t) : option (lexical t) =
    optionm.map (fun v => lexical { value = v; text = text }) value

inl whole_of (text : string) : option i64 =
    if sm'.index_of "." text >= 0i32 then None
    else optionm.map (fun (d : decimal.decimal) => d.units) (decimal.parse text)

inl whole_at_least (least : i64) (text : string) : option i64 =
    match whole_of text with
    | Some n => if n >= least then Some n else None
    | None => None

inl boolean_of (text : string) : option bool =
    match xml.collapsed_space text with
    | "true" => Some true
    | "1" => Some true
    | "false" => Some false
    | "0" => Some false
    | _ => None

type xsd_boolean = lexical bool

inl xsd_boolean_of_string (s : string) : option xsd_boolean = lexical_of s (boolean_of s)

inl xsd_boolean_example (_ : i32) : xsd_boolean = lexical { value = true; text = "true" }

inl xsd_boolean_example_text (_ : i32) : string = "true"

    | PaymentMethodType_OTHER

    match s with
    | "TRANSFER" => Some PaymentMethodType_TRANSFER
    | "CASH" => Some PaymentMethodType_CASH
    | "CARD" => Some PaymentMethodType_CARD
    | "VOUCHER" => Some PaymentMethodType_VOUCHER
    | "OTHER" => Some PaymentMethodType_OTHER
    | _ => None

    match x with
    | PaymentMethodType_TRANSFER => "TRANSFER"
    | PaymentMethodType_CASH => "CASH"
    | PaymentMethodType_CARD => "CARD"
    | PaymentMethodType_VOUCHER => "VOUCHER"
    | PaymentMethodType_OTHER => "OTHER"

instance to_text x_payment_method_type = fun x => x_payment_method_type_to_string x

inl x_payment_method_type_example (k : i32) : x_payment_method_type =
    inl index = ((k % 5i32) + 5i32) % 5i32
    if index = 0i32 then PaymentMethodType_TRANSFER
    elif index = 1i32 then PaymentMethodType_CASH
    elif index = 2i32 then PaymentMethodType_CARD

nominal private x_data_name_type = string

inl x_data_name_type_is_valid (s : string) : bool =
    xsd_regex.table_matches (xsd_pattern_9a762a0e_32_table ()) s
    && xml.code_point_count s >= 1
    && xml.code_point_count s <= 255

inl x_data_name_type_of_string (s : string) : option x_data_name_type =
    if x_data_name_type_is_valid s then Some (x_data_name_type s) else None

inl x_data_name_type_to_string (x : x_data_name_type) : string = match x with x_data_name_type s => s

instance to_text x_data_name_type = fun x => x_data_name_type_to_string x
inl x_data_name_type_example (_ : i32) : x_data_name_type = x_data_name_type "A00000_0"

inl x_data_name_type_example_text (k : i32) : string = x_data_name_type_to_string (x_data_name_type_example k)

union x_customer_vat_status_type =
    | CustomerVatStatusType_DOMESTIC
    | CustomerVatStatusType_OTHER
    | CustomerVatStatusType_PRIVATE_PERSON

inl x_customer_vat_status_type_of_string (s : string) : option x_customer_vat_status_type =
    match s with
    | "DOMESTIC" => Some CustomerVatStatusType_DOMESTIC
    | "OTHER" => Some CustomerVatStatusType_OTHER
    | "PRIVATE_PERSON" => Some CustomerVatStatusType_PRIVATE_PERSON
    | _ => None

inl x_customer_vat_status_type_to_string (x : x_customer_vat_status_type) : string =
    match x with
    | CustomerVatStatusType_DOMESTIC => "DOMESTIC"
    | CustomerVatStatusType_OTHER => "OTHER"
    | CustomerVatStatusType_PRIVATE_PERSON => "PRIVATE_PERSON"

instance to_text x_customer_vat_status_type = fun x => x_customer_vat_status_type_to_string x

inl x_customer_vat_status_type_example (k : i32) : x_customer_vat_status_type =
    inl index = ((k % 3i32) + 3i32) % 3i32
    if index = 0i32 then CustomerVatStatusType_DOMESTIC
    elif index = 1i32 then CustomerVatStatusType_OTHER
    else CustomerVatStatusType_PRIVATE_PERSON

inl x_customer_vat_status_type_example_text (k : i32) : string =
    x_customer_vat_status_type_to_string (x_customer_vat_status_type_example k)
